title: Khalad aan macno lahayn
description: Sheekadan waxay gaadhaysaa xadka xusuusta AI-ga, sida looxa cadaanka oo buuxsamaya. Waxaan ballaarin karnaa daaqadda xusuusta (oo loo yaqaano cabbirka macnaha) si ay u xafiddo wax badan, laakiin waxay qaadan kartaa xusuusta kombiyuutarkaaga. Sidoo kale waan goyn karnaa xogta galinta, taasoo micnaheedu yahay inay ilaawdo qaar ka mid ah taariikhda sheekada si meesha loo siiyo fariimaha cusub.
increaseContextSizeDescription: Ma rabtaa inaad kordhiso cabbirka macnaha?
lastRequestOverflowed: Codsigii ugu dambeeyay ayaa daaqadda macnaha ka buuxiyey.
contextOverflowDetail: Codsigan wuxuu u baahday {{request}} calaamado, laakiin daaqadda macnaha moodelku waxay qabsan kartaa kaliya {{context}}.
contextOverflowGeneric: Codsiga ayaa ka badan cabbirka macnaha ee la heli karo.
emptyReply: Muuqaalka ayaa dhameystay iyada oo aan jawaab la soo celin. Isku day inaad dib u soo saarto, ama hubi dejimaha bixiyaha.

engine.unknown: Mashiinka moodeelka ayaa soo sheegay qalad lama filaan ah.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_FAILED: Moodeelka ma la soo dejin karo.
engine.MODEL_ARCH_NOT_SUPPORTED: Qaab-dhismeedka moodeelkan lama taageero mashiinka hadda jira. Cusboonaysiinta mashiinka ee Settings waxay keeni kartaa taageero.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_TIMED_OUT: Moodeelku wuxuu qaadatay waqti dheer inuu soo rogo waxaana la joojiyay. Moodeel ka yar ama cabbir macne oo yar ayaa caadi ahaan caawiya.
engine.MISSING_SHARED_LIBRARY: Maktabad uu mashiinku u baahan yahay ayaa maqan, sidaas darteed ma bilaabi karo.
engine.GPU_DRIVER_TOO_OLD: Darawalkaaga GPU waa duug aad u mashiinkan. Cusboonaysiinta darawalka, ama u beddelidda mashiinka CPU ee Settings, ayaa hagaajin doona arrintan.
engine.OUT_OF_MEMORY: Xusuus ku filan ma jirto si moodeelkan loo wado. Moodeel ka yar ama cabbir macne oo yar ayaa caadi ahaan caawiya.
engine.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Mid ka mid ah dejimaha moodeelka ayaa aan sax ahayn.
engine.IO_ERROR: Fayl lama akhrin ama lama qorin marka la bilaabayay moodeelka.
engine.INTERNAL_ERROR: Wax qaldamay gudaha Novera markii la bilaabayay moodeelka.
engine.ENGINE_UNREACHABLE: Matoorka llama.cpp wuu socdaa, laakiin Novera ma ku xiriiri karo kombuyuutarkan (127.0.0.1). VPN, proxy ama software amni ayaa laga yaabaa inuu xannibo xiriirada maxaliga ah.
engine.ENGINE_STOPPED: Matoorka llama.cpp wuu istaagay si lama filaan ah. Marka farriinta mar kale la diro, wuu bilaabanayaa; haddii uu sii joogsado, software-ka amniga ama darawalka GPU ayaa laga yaabaa inuu sabab u yahay.
engine.UNSUPPORTED_CPU: Moodooyinka maxaliga ah looma taageero processor-ka kombuyuutarkan. Matoorka maxaliga ah ee Novera waxaa loo dhisay Apple Silicon Macs (M1 ama ka cusub), sidaas darteed ma bilaaban karo Mac Intel. Adeeg bixiyeyaasha daruuriga iyo kuwa gaarka ah wali way shaqeynayaan.
